title: Dubai Atlantis Hotel Package
shortDescription: Two indulgent nights at the iconic Atlantis, The Palm — home to Aquaventure Waterpark and The Lost Chambers Aquarium — with the essential Dubai experiences built in.
description: Two indulgent nights at the iconic Atlantis, The Palm — home to Aquaventure Waterpark and The Lost Chambers Aquarium — with the essential Dubai experiences built in.
Your stay includes a half-day city tour, an evening desert safari with dune bashing, belly dancing and a barbecue dinner, and a dinner cruise aboard a traditional dhow.
